definitions.explanation: A form of gambling where numbered tickets are sold and winners are selected by drawing. Also refers to the ticket itself.

examples.japanese: {宝|たから}くじ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
{宝|たから}くじ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧{等|とう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{当|あ}たった→当たる：01860_ataru⟧。
examples.english: I won third prize in the lottery.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年末|ねんまつ}→年末：17688_nenmatsu⟧ジャンボ{宝|たから}くじ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{話題|わだい}→話題：03793_wadai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The year-end Jumbo Lottery becomes a big topic every year.

notes:
USAGE:
One of the most popular forms of legal gambling in Japan. Tickets are sold at dedicated lottery booths ({宝|たから}くじ⟦{売|う}り{場|ば}→売り場：01331_uriba⟧) often found near train stations. Major drawings include the year-end Jumbo (⟦{年末|ねんまつ}→年末：17688_nenmatsu⟧ジャンボ) and Summer Jumbo (サマージャンボ).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {宝|たから}くじ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧ (to buy a lottery ticket)
- {宝|たから}くじ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{当|あ}たる→当たる：01860_ataru⟧ (to win the lottery)
- {宝|たから}くじ⟦{売|う}り{場|ば}→売り場：01331_uriba⟧ (lottery ticket booth)
- {宝|たから}くじ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{外|はず}れる→外れる：02395_hazureru⟧ (to lose the lottery)

WRITING:
Also written as {宝籤|たからくじ}, but the mixed kana/kanji spelling {宝|たから}くじ is standard.
